theme: Reconstructing a room from its echoes
title: Echo Room: Wall Reconstruction from Unlabeled First-Order Echoes
strategies: data-blind generic room: place W walls at a fixed generic radius from the source, evenly spread in angle, ignoring every echo reading
two-microphone multilateration: sort each of the first two microphones' readings and pair them by rank, circle-intersect with a fixed handedness convention, never cross-checking any other microphone

cross-microphone consistency filter: enumerate image-point candidates from every microphone pair and every reading pair, keep only candidates that are also consistent with EVERY other microphone's reading list, and reconstruct the W walls whose image points survive that global consistency filter
